geometryRules: LONG: stop < executable entry < TP1 < TP2 < TP3.
SHORT: stop > executable entry > TP1 > TP2 > TP3.
A target must have causal structural/volatility provenance; an arbitrary R multiple alone is not enough for a structural target.
A stop must be outside the declared invalidation/noise boundary and inside the maximum accepted risk cap.
No widening stop or extending TP solely to repair RR.
managementRules: Break-even movement requires a predeclared state transition; it cannot be discretionary hindsight.
Partial exits must be included in net expectancy and cost accounting.
Same-bar stop/target ambiguity defaults to the adverse ordering unless lower-timeframe sequence is available.
Time stops are market/timeframe specific and must be validated, not assumed.

scoreRules.heuristicScores: Allowed only when explicitly labelled score/rank.
scoreRules.probability: Allowed only after out-of-sample calibration with reliability metrics.
scoreRules.grade: A/B/C grades require an empirically frozen mapping; otherwise use descriptive evidence labels.

noTradePrinciple: The engine is allowed to abstain. Trade count is not a success metric; net expectancy, robustness, risk and opportunity recall are.
